recipe.text: Fresh melee-brute concept (Stone Golem) distinct from prior husks/enemies: light stone body with emissive eyes and moss accent limbs for readability. Slow (speed 6), high damage (40), short detect (24) per brief. Standard R15-style assembly welded to a collidable HRP; make_npc supplies server-authoritative idle->chase->attack->dead AI. State attribute reads idle at rest, will flip to attack when a player is within range 7.
